name: HD Hyundai Electric
description: South Korean heavy-electrical OEM, spun out of Hyundai Heavy Industries in April 2017 and renamed HD Hyundai Electric in 2023: power and distribution transformers, gas-insulated switchgear, HV circuit breakers, HV/LV motors and generators, HVDC equipment and battery storage. HD Hyundai Co., Ltd. is the largest shareholder at 35.60% (KRX: 267260), and it is a major supplier to Asian transmission utilities.
